verdict.rationale: This axis applies: a government immigration agency's online portal has a sign-in path that can be judged on whether it uses remotely completable credential MFA or requires biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN. The only evidence is a TLS-verification failure on robots.txt, where nothing on the host was fetched. It says nothing about AIMA's authentication method, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.
